extDescription.message: Shows an e-mail conversation as a chat: bubbles, live updates, quick reply.

sendFailed.message: Not sent: $1. Your text is in the compose window.

editorTitle.message: Open the reply in the full compose window

bodyFailed.message: Could not load the text. Open the message to read it.

optAutoOpen.message: Clicking a collapsed thread opens it as a chat

optAutoOpenHint.message: Thunderbird shows its own summary page for a collapsed thread, and add-ons cannot change that page. With this on, the first message of the thread is selected instead, which expands the thread in the list.

optMarkRead.message: Mark all messages shown in the chat as read

searchOlderTitle.message: The conversation refers to messages that were not found within two months of this one. Search all folders of the account (Thunderbird may freeze for a moment).

countHidden.message: Messages in conversation: $1 (the $2 earliest are not shown)

fromTitle.message: Account the reply is sent from

bigMessage.message: Large message ($1): its text is not loaded automatically.

quoteTitle.message: Put the selected text into the reply as a quote
